sentences.text: Sri Raj Kumar Dhanuka vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on

Author: Subhasis Dasgupta
Bench: Subhasis Dasgupta
22 15.02.
Agm 2019
 C.R.R. 311 of 2019
Ct 41

Sri Raj Kumar Dhanuka
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Mr. Amlan Jyoti Sengupta,
 Mr. Chandan Misra,
 Ms. Sarada Sah,
 .... For the Petitioner.

The impugned order dated 18th December, 2018 passed by Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Tehatta in G.R. Case No. 572 of 2018 arising out of Karimpur Police Station Case No. 103 of 2018 dated 12th June, 2018, is the subject of assail in this case.
By the impugned order, the Trial Court issued warrant of arrest against accused Raj Kumar Dhanuka.

It is the admitted case of the revisionist that the items seized were recovered from revisionist, which was ultimately returned by the Court below considering the seized items to be perishable in nature.

According to learned advocate for the revisionist the facts impleading the accused in this case was very much within the knowledge of the Court, and it was considered in its right perspective while making return of the seized items to him.

From the certified copy of the order of the Trial Court dated 20th December, 2018, it appears that one Bishnu Prosad Kedia, in whose favour the power of attorney was executed by the revisionist empowering him to initiate the prayer for return made such prayer and the Trial Court upon consideration of the entire aspect in the context of report of I.O.
returned the seized items upon execution of zimma bond to Bishnu Prosad Kedia, the person in whose favour the power of attorney was executed by the revisionist.
The investigation is continuing at this stage.
In a situation like this, a direction is, therefore, felt obligatory in the interest of justice.

Let the impugned order dated 18th December, 2018 passed by learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Tehatta in G.R. Case No. 572 of 2018 under Sections 272/273/420/120B of the Indian Sri Raj Kumar Dhanuka vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 15 February, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156185144/
1 Penal Code read with Section 16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and Sections 51/54/57/63 of the Food, Safety and Standard Act, 2006.be stayed for fortnight from hence subject to the condition that revisionist will surrender before the Court below within the time mentioned hereinabove.

With these directions, the revisional application stands disposed of.
